assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Removing the automatic inactive vertical-position row (reverting commit 3748d5e18) makes len(step.inner_receipt.constraints) one short of len(request.constraint_pairs)+1, so the assertion reddens; the count clause is independent of the code under test because its right-hand side is built from the request the test declared.

The row-identity clause compares physical_residual against normalized_unknown of the same code-produced row; for an active row these diverge and it reddens, but for a row whose two fields are both the held unknown (including zero) it can hold trivially, so it corroborates rather than independently guards the inactivity.
